prompt: Merge any number of already-ascending lists into one ascending list by repeatedly taking the smallest head, without concatenating and sorting. Complete merge, skipping null or empty inputs.
explanation: Instead of copying everything and sorting, keep one cursor per input list and repeatedly pick whichever cursor points at the smallest remaining value. A cursor that has reached the end of its list is simply skipped, so lists of different lengths need no special handling. Because every round emits exactly one value, the loop can run until no cursor has anything left -- and duplicates come out naturally, once per occurrence.
hints: Keep an int[] of cursors, one per input list, all starting at 0 -- that array is the whole state of the merge.
Each round, scan the cursors to find the list whose current element is smallest, add that element, and advance only that one cursor.
Skip null and empty lists when you scan, and stop when no list has a remaining element.
